replacements.new:
<OBJECT VETERAN-HOLD-TRUNK
    (SYNONYM TRUNK HOLD LOCKER CHEST)
    (ADJECTIVE VETERAN ATTIC FIELD)
    (DESC "veteran hold trunk")
    (LDESC "A stout veteran hold trunk waits beside the completed-expedition boxes.")
    (FLAGS CONTBIT OPENBIT SEARCHBIT TRYTAKEBIT)
    (CAPACITY 200)>

<OBJECT VETERAN-ARCHIVE-WORK-LIGHT
    (SYNONYM LIGHT LAMP FIXTURE)
    (ADJECTIVE FIXED ARCHIVE WORK ATTIC)
    (DESC "fixed archive work light")
    (LDESC "A fixed archive work light casts a steady pool across the expedition boxes.")
    (FLAGS LIGHTBIT ONBIT TRYTAKEBIT)
    (ACTION VETERAN-ARCHIVE-WORK-LIGHT-FCN)>

<ROUTINE VETERAN-ARCHIVE-WORK-LIGHT-FCN ()
    <COND (<VERB? TAKE>
           <TELL "The archive work light is bolted to the rafters." CR>
           <RTRUE>)
          (<VERB? LAMP-OFF>
           <TELL "The fixed work light has no local switch; it remains on for the expedition archive." CR>
           <RTRUE>)
          (<VERB? LAMP-ON>
           <TELL "The archive work light is already on." CR>
           <RTRUE>)
          (<VERB? EXAMINE>
           <TELL "The fixed lamp illuminates the expedition boxes without becoming another portable field item." CR>
           <RTRUE>)>
    <RFALSE>>

<ROUTINE VETERAN-DISPATCH-FCN ()
